newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-Regal purchase to enhance earnings.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Regal purchase to enhance earnings.

text.p: Acquisitive British hotels firm Regal Hotel Group Plc said on Friday that its key focus is on earnings and the rate at which it bought hotels would be a little less frantic than of late.

The company boosted its network of primarily three star UK hotels to 95 today when it announced the purchase of 13 three star hotels from Whitbread Plc for 64.5 million stg in cash. This follows Regal's acquisition of 60 White Hart properties from Granada Group Plc for 122 million stg last year.
"I think you can safely say that (we will be less active on the acquisition front)," Charles Vere Nicoll, executive chairman of the group, told Reuters.
"We needed to build a national brand and that is what we have done with this acquisition. Our key focus is earnings and clearly this will be earnings enhancing," he said in an interview.
Regal is funding its latest purchase through a placing and open offer to raise 36.6 million stg and also plans a debenture stock issue to raise another 35 million stg.
Vere Nicoll said the company planned to reduce its gearing, the ratio of a company's debt to equity, to 50 percent from 67 percent.
The company said that performance so far this year has been in line with expectations and believes that this will continue to be the case for the rest of 1997.
Regal said in February that it had boosted pretax profits to 10.43 million for 1996 from 2.91 million in the previous year.
